mapper.select: SELECT BANK_CD, BANK_NM, BANK_TYPE, SORT_ORDER, USE_YN FROM TB_BANK_CODE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, BANK_CD ASC
SELECT BANK_CD, BANK_NM, BANK_TYPE, SORT_ORDER, USE_YN FROM TB_BANK_CODE WHERE BANK_CD = #{bankCd}
SELECT LOAN_NO, MEMBER_ID, CUST_NM, PRODUCT_NM, BANK_CD, BANK_NM, ACCOUNT_NO, ACCOUNT_HOLDER_NM, ACCOUNT_TYPE, REG_DT FROM TB_LOAN_ACCOUNT WHERE LOAN_NO = #{loanNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT LOAN_NO, MEMBER_ID, CUST_NM, PRODUCT_NM, BANK_CD, BANK_NM, ACCOUNT_NO, ACCOUNT_HOLDER_NM, ACCOUNT_TYPE, REG_DT FROM TB_LOAN_ACCOUNT WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY REG_DT DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ACCOUNT_CERT_HIST ( REQ_TX_SEQ, MEMBER_ID, CUST_NM, BANK_CD, BANK_NM, ACCOUNT_NO, ACCOUNT_HOLDER_NM, AUTH_CODE, PRINT_TEXT, STATUS, PURPOSE, LOAN_NO, IS_MODIFIED, FAIL_CNT, EXPIRE_DT, CLIENT_IP, USER_AGENT, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{reqTxSeq}, #{memberId}, #{custNm}, #{bankCd}, #{bankNm}, #{accountNo}, #{accountHolderNm}, #{authCode}, #{printText}, #{status}, #{purpose}, #{loanNo}, #{isModified}, 0, #{expireDt}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT REQ_TX_SEQ, MEMBER_ID, CUST_NM, BANK_CD, BANK_NM, ACCOUNT_NO, ACCOUNT_HOLDER_NM, AUTH_CODE, PRINT_TEXT, STATUS, PURPOSE, LOAN_NO, IS_MODIFIED, FAIL_CNT, EXPIRE_DT, VERIFY_DT, CLIENT_IP, USER_AGENT, REG_DT FROM TB_ACCOUNT_CERT_HIST WHERE REQ_TX_SEQ = #{reqTxSeq}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ACCOUNT_CERT_HIST SET STATUS = 'VERIFIED', VERIFY_DT = NOW() WHERE REQ_TX_SEQ = #{reqTxSeq}
